what_it_does: Foldable phones need compact, efficient systems to charge their batteries via both wired charging cables and wireless charging pads, while also powering external devices wirelessly (battery sharing). Existing charger designs are bulky and inefficient. This paper describes a 3-level bidirectional charger that combines wired and wireless paths into a single compact circuit, using a frequency-balancing technique to keep current stable and a wide voltage-conversion capability that eliminates the need for separate circuit paths for different power levels.
